original_test_intent: Verify that crossing the configured AMD GPU bad-page threshold produces the specified retirement-threshold CPER semantics in addition to the injected ODECC/GFX records and observable bad-page state.
original_method: On an approved disposable target, preserve state, perform the source-owned RAS EEPROM clear and reset, load the exact approved threshold configuration, establish CPER/bad-page baselines, execute the approved threshold-crossing injection sequence, securely retrieve/decode the correlated CPER and restore the approved platform state.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE resolves the threshold-crossing sequence and field semantics; the owner approves erasing RAS EEPROM for all named devices, reset and driver mutation, while an operator monitors recovery.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/OAM/card-to-device mapping including whether devices 0..7 all exist and are in scope
Authoritative threshold value and pre-threshold retired-page state
Exact number/order/target of injections required to cross the threshold and expected pages per injection
Approved EEPROM-clear/reset/modprobe lifecycle and original driver configuration for restoration
Expected CPER multiplicity/correlation and definitions for RMA or disabled-page behavior
Secure CPER resource/transfer and independent recovery plan
safety_requirements: Treat clearing RAS EEPROM across eight device indices as destructive and require explicit inventory-bound approval
Drain workload and preserve all pre-clear RAS/CPER/bad-page/log evidence before mutation
Do not assume one injection crosses threshold 16 or repeat injections until it does; use a bounded approved sequence
Use verified TLS, structured Redfish parsing and protected credentials/transfer
Stop on unexpected device population, CPER count, driver failure, platform health change or recovery issue; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect immutable identity, device map, driver parameters, bad pages, CPER and health baselines
After approval, clear exactly authorized RAS EEPROM targets, perform the approved reset and load the approved driver parameters
Execute only the supplied finite threshold-crossing injection sequence and record each mutation/result
Acquire/hash/decode correlated CPER artifacts and compare all required UMC/GC records and bad-page state
Restore approved driver/RAS state and package evidence without deciding DUT PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Resolve the source's threshold-16 versus single-injection ambiguity and define exact crossing sequence/stop point
Approve eight-device clear scope, reset, driver state, CPER interpretation and recovery
Review raw threshold/bad-page/CPER and final-health evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: EEPROM clear, reset, thresholded driver load and injection are relevant to this row, but neither source nor DeepSeek defines how the listed injection crosses threshold 16 or whether it yields all three required CPER record classes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute an engineer-supplied finite manifest that binds each authorized device clear, reset, driver parameter and injection to before/after bad-page counts and correlated hashed CPER artifacts; never loop until an outcome appears.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device loop 0..7, ras_enable=1, literal bad_page_threshold=16, reboot/warm-reset choice, GFX block 2 type 8, CPER +1, every UMC/GC field and 5/10-minute estimates remain pending authoritative resolution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed run manifest with initial retired-page count, threshold arithmetic, expected pages per injection, maximum injections and expected CPER cardinality before any irreversible clear; capture every intermediate state and stop exactly at the approved boundary.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the missing threshold-crossing sequence explicit and replaces hardcoded HTTP/grep/SCP handling with secure structured artifact correlation and recoverable state control.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful single injection and CPER +1 do not by themselves prove threshold exceed; the retirement-threshold record and bad-page/RMA transition must be causally tied to an explicitly defined crossing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: EEPROM clearing destroys historical RAS state, driver reload changes live behavior, and repeated injection can disable memory pages or destabilize the GPU. These cannot be inferred or retried opportunistically.

project_override_considerations: If project firmware intentionally retires multiple pages per injection or defines threshold semantics differently, the approved decision must state the arithmetic and expected CPER records while retaining the literal Master requirements for traceability.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/OAM/card/device/firmware/driver/tool identity
Engineering decision resolving threshold value, starting count, injection count and expected bad-page/CPER transition
Preserved pre-clear RAS/CPER/log evidence plus authorization for device 0..7 clear/reset/driver change
Per-step command/status and before/intermediate/after bad-page lists
Raw CPER indexes/attachments/hashes and decoded UMC-threshold, UMC-ODECC and GC-poison fields
Restored driver/RAS state, final platform health, no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source configures bad_page_threshold=16 but lists only one injection and does not state the initial retired-page count, pages created per injection or a bounded repetition sequence. Therefore the procedure does not reliably establish the title/criteria's threshold-exceeded condition or required threshold CPER record.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ambiguity blocks DUT execution and verdict but not the static review; it is recorded for engineering resolution while the remaining library proceeds.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 1957 Wistron-AMD SVM-00037-V003: define the authoritative initial bad-page state, threshold (source says 16), exact finite injection sequence/pages-per-injection and expected CPER cardinality that prove threshold exceed; also approve the device 0..7 RAS EEPROM clear, reset/driver lifecycle and restoration while preserving all Master criteria.

review_improvement: Separates threshold proof from generic injection success, exposes destructive preconditioning, and requires a finite causally correlated sequence for every required CPER class.
independent_technical_reasoning: Threshold behavior is a boundary condition, so the evidence must show a transition from below to at/above the configured limit. Without starting count and per-injection retirement behavior, one successful GFX injection cannot establish that transition. Clearing EEPROM may make the starting count deterministic but also destroys evidence and broadens blast radius to eight indices; it is therefore an explicit test mutation, not harmless setup. The run must also distinguish the threshold-notification UMC record from the ODECC UMC and poison-consumption GC records rather than treating any decoded CPER as sufficient.
